SASBDB entry SASDRX8  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDRX8/)

Publication: The missing part: the Archaeoglobus fulgidus Argonaute forms a functional
heterodimer with an N-L1-L2 domain protein.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkad1241   (Nucleic Acids Res 2024, PMID 38197228)

The publisher's PDF is not kept in this folder (size, and the publisher's redistribution
terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDRX8/ takes
its buffer and sample conditions from the SASBDB entry only.

Files: experimental_data/SASDRX8.dat (curve in nm^-1), SASDRX8_fit1_model1.pdb and
SASDRX8_fit2_model1.pdb (the deposited atomic models, taken from PDB 8OK9),
SASDRX8_fit1.fit and SASDRX8_fit2.fit (deposited CRYSOL 2.8.4 fits, q in A^-1). The
GASBOR dummy-atom fit3 is not kept.
